kami.description: Convert PDF to plain text via poppler-utils pdftotext. The binary must be on the cell runtime's PATH (apt: poppler-utils, brew: poppler).

ops.name: convert
ops.summary: Convert a PDF file to plain text
ops.description: Invoke `pdftotext [flags] <pdf_file> [text_file]`. When `text_file` is '-' (default) the result lands on stdout; the cell captures stdout and returns it in the response.

argv.name: layout
argv.description: Maintain (as best as possible) original physical layout.

argv.name: raw
argv.description: Keep strings in content stream order.

argv.name: encoding
argv.description: Output text encoding name (e.g. UTF-8, Latin1).

argv.name: pdf_file
argv.description: Input PDF path on the cell runtime filesystem.

argv.name: text_file
argv.description: Output text path; '-' (default) sends to stdout, which the cell captures.
